observed.caption: A sunny urban park with benches and palm trees in the foreground and two tall high-rise buildings in the background under a clear blue sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban park in bright daylight. In the immediate foreground there is short grass with two concrete benches, one on the lower left and one on the lower right, with a person sitting on the right bench. A low trimmed hedge runs horizontally across the middle foreground behind the benches, bordering a larger dry grassy lawn enclosed by small black-and-white posts. Several palm trees and leafy green trees are scattered throughout the park, with a prominent tall palm on the right side. Behind the park a road with small distant vehicles is visible. In the background two tall multi-story buildings dominate the skyline, the left one with a tall antenna structure on its roof and the right one a brown rectangular tower, with additional smaller buildings and trees between them. The sky is clear and light blue.
